data.explanation: This is a bill for electrical work done in your home on 17 March 2026. The total is €1,214.99 including 19% VAT (Umsatzsteuer). Pay it by bank transfer to the IBAN shown, using the invoice number as the reference, by the deadline shown, with no deduction. If anything looks wrong, contact the company before paying. Keep the invoice: labour costs for work in your home may be deductible in your tax return.
